split_policy: Question variants share a group and a split. Validation target groups are not in training or the earlier 12-example smoke set. Evidence snippets are copied exactly from uploaded passages. Splits share source articles; this is not an article-disjoint or final held-out benchmark. Refusal capabilities can overlap across groups.
limitations: Assistant-authored labels; no independent human approval.
Near-paraphrase and intent exclusion are an assistant review, not a certified automated semantic guarantee.
Some training facts were previously used in the smoke run; start the new experiment from the pinned base model, not the smoke adapter.
Do not concatenate the smoke dataset into these splits.
Validation is for tuning; retain a separate final test set.
These are short evidence snippets, not a full end-to-end retrieval benchmark.
